pr_title: Add point in time to HLRC
pr_comment: @mayya-sharipova Thanks so much for your review.

@dnhatn I am not finding the newly added docs in the 7.x nor master docs for the high level REST client. Maybe I am looking in the wrong place. Can you double check that it got published and it is where you would expect it?
@javanna The docs isn't linked properly. I've opened https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/73874 to fix it. Thanks for the ping.

review_comment: I was thinking that open and delete PIT APIs should return almost instantly,  thus is there a need for `openPointInTimeAsync`  and `closePointInTimeAsync` ?  Or, am I wrong, and there are cases when these APIs may take some time?
Yes, it should be fast unless the request hits many indices or the cluster is not functioning. But here I merely follow the convention in HLRC that is returning Cancellable in *Async methods.
It is good to add `OpenPointInTimeResponseTests` to check serialization from and to XContent. But I don't mind if we do it in a following PR.
Can you please explain what's the need for this change?

This is a bit messy. ClosePointInTimeResponse extends ClearScrollResponse, and this change just ensures that `fromXContent` method returns an instance of ClosePointInTimeResponse. I will work on a small PR to clean up this.
